```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(jsonlite)

source(here("mogp-utils.R"))
```

The purpose of this notebook is to generate draws from a multi-output spectral mixture Gaussian process with known hyperparameter values:

- $w_i$: magnitude/weight
- $\Sigma_i$: spectral width/variance
- $\mu_i$: spectral frequency/mean
- $\theta_i$: delay
- $\phi_i$: phase

```{r}
D <- 2
Q <- 3

n_points_per_band <- 200

pct_missing <- 0.2
noise_sigma <- 0.5

output <- NULL

output <- sim_D2_Q(
  tstart = 0,
  tend = 10,
  n_per_band = n_points_per_band, 
  masked_pct = pct_missing,
  Q = Q,
  params = list(
    w = rbind(c(3, 3),
              c(0.5, 0.5),
              c(1, 1)),
    mu = rbind(c(0.5, 0.5),
               c(20, 21),
               c(0.1, 0.2)),
    Sigma = rbind(c(1, 1),
                  c(1, 1),
                  c(1, 4)),
    theta = rbind(c(0, 0.1),
                  c(0, 0),
                  c(0, 0.1)),
    phi = rbind(c(0, 0),
                c(0, 0),
                c(0, 0))),
  noise_sd = rep(noise_sigma, D)#, seed = 4458
)

output_params <- output[[1]]
output_df <- output[[2]]

#output_params

output_df |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t, colour = d, alpha = ifelse(masked, 0.2, 1)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymax = y + y_se, ymin = y - y_se), colour = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(y = y)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = f), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_rug(aes(y = y), sides = "b", position = "jitter") +
  labs(title = glue("Seed = {output_params$seed}, M = {sum(!output_df$masked)}")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
str(output_df)
```

```{r}
output_filename_stub <- glue("D{D}-Q{Q}-seed{output_params$seed[1]}-n{n_points_per_band*D}-mnar{pct_missing}-noise{noise_sigma}")

df_output_filename <- glue("{output_filename_stub}-sim.csv")
param_output_filename <- glue("{output_filename_stub}-param.json")

write_csv(output_df, here("data", df_output_filename))

write_json(output_params, here("data", param_output_filename), pretty = TRUE)

read_json(here("data", param_output_filename), simplifyVector = TRUE)
```
